title: Mexican Grilled Corn Flatbread
description: A delicious and easy flatbread topped with grilled portuguese corn, perfect for a mexican-inspired meal.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Grill the portuguese corn until slightly charred, about 5-7 minutes per side.
3. Meanwhile, toast the flatbread on the grill or in a toaster.
4. Sprinkle the toasted chili powder over the flatbread.
5. Brush the grilled corn with a tablespoon of butter or oil.
6. Assemble the flatbread by topping it with the grilled corn, salt, and optional grilled cheese crumbles.
